Random variables

Source: R/stats.R
Normal.Rd

Constructors for random symbols with exact symbolic distributions, after sympy.stats: continuous Normal, Uniform, Exponential, GammaRV, BetaRV, ChiSquared, StudentT, Cauchy, Laplace, LogNormal, Weibull, Pareto; discrete Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson, Geometric, Die and Coin. Parameters may be symbolic; give them assumptions such as positive = TRUE so that integrals converge.

Usage

Normal(name, mu, sigma)

Uniform(name, a, b)

Exponential(name, rate)

GammaRV(name, k, theta)

BetaRV(name, alpha, beta)

ChiSquared(name, k)

StudentT(name, nu)

Cauchy(name, x0, gamma)

Laplace(name, mu, b)

LogNormal(name, mu, sigma)

Weibull(name, alpha, beta)

Pareto(name, x0, alpha)

Bernoulli(name, p)

Coin(name, p = Rational(1, 2))

Die(name, sides = 6)

Binomial(name, n, p)

Poisson(name, lamda)

Geometric(name, p)

E(expr)

expectation(expr)

moment(X, k)

cmoment(X, k)

variance(X)

std(X)

covariance(X, Y)

correlation(X, Y)

skewness(X)

kurtosis(X)

rv_density(X, z = Symbol("z"))

rv_cdf(X, z = Symbol("z"))

P(condition)

rv_sample(X, size = 1)

Arguments

name

Display name.

mu, sigma, a, b, rate, k, theta, alpha, beta, nu, x0, gamma, p, n, sides, lamda

Distribution parameters.

expr

An expression in random variables.

X, Y

Random variables or expressions in them.

z

Symbol for density and distribution functions.

condition

A relational in one random variable.

size

Number of draws.

Value

A random symbol, expression or numeric vector.

Details

E(expr) (alias expectation()) is the expected value, using closed form moments when known and integration or summation otherwise. variance(), std(), moment(), cmoment(), skewness(), kurtosis(), covariance() and correlation() build on it. P(condition) is the probability of an event in one random variable. rv_density(X) gives the density or mass function and rv_cdf(X) the distribution function, both as expressions in the variable z. Random variables in a product or sum are treated as independent. rv_sample(X, n) draws numeric samples.

Examples

mu <- Symbol("mu", real = TRUE); s <- Symbol("s", positive = TRUE)
X <- Normal("X", mu, s)
E(X^2)
#> mu^2 + s^2
variance(2 * X + 1)
#> 4*s^2
Z <- Normal("Z", 0, 1)
P(Z > 0)
#> 1/2
D <- Die("D", 6)
E(D)
#> 7/2
